source_figure: Mohamed et al. 2008, printed p.8 / PDF p.18, Habitat Area figure
source_domain: Karnataka shelf and parts of slope, 12–15 N and 73–76 E; exploitation to200 m,300 km coast,27,000 km2. The coordinate rectangle is not the study footprint.

containment_check.purpose: Checks whether the source-stated marine coordinate envelope intersects other marine regions. Not substituted for S.
